additional_info.subject: RE: AW: RE: 0445544 - ID0445544-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP/R9 170002768]Credit card terminal activation CRM:00373000828
additional_info.body:
Hallo Sascha Hallo Lorenz
ich habe jetzt mit CCV abgestimmt das wir das Tool und die Zertifikate mit euch teilen dürfen. Bitte tool installieren falls möglich an den Techniker Laptops:
Ansonsten bleibt nur das Companion tool
Kurzfassung:
within TS3:
Fernsteuerung >>> Start >>> Service >>> Inbetriebnahme >>> Sprache auswählen >>> TID bestätigen >>> PU auswählen >>> DHCP: nein >>> IP = 10.20.17.50 bestätigen >>> Subnetz = 255.255.255.0 >>> Gateway = 10.20.17.2 bestätigen >>> Kassenanbindung: nein
Functions:
Terminal Commissioning
IMPORTANT: IT IS STRONGLY RECOMMENDED TO USE THE COMPANION TOOL FOR COMMISSIONING IN THE FIRST STEP !!!
Switch on the OPx. After the start, the OPM indicates the completion of the boot process with a signal tone.
Start the TS3 (see above). You require a license with level 3 or higher.
Check connection settings as desribed before (see above).
Follow the steps:
Remote Control >>> Start >>> Service >>> Initiation>>> Select Language >>> Type in 8-digit TID >>> Choose the PU >>> DHCP: no >>> IP = 10.20.17.50 >>> Subnet = 255.255.255.0 >>> Gateway = 10.20.17.2 >>> Cash Register connection: no
How to change PU (= Processing Unit)
Start the TS3 (see above). You require a license with level 3 or higher.
Check connection settings as desribed before (see above).
Follow the steps:
Remote Control >>> Start >>> Service >>> Initiation>>> Select Language >>> Type in 8-digit TID >>> Choose the PU >>> DHCP: no >>> IP = 10.20.17.50 >>> Subnet = 255.255.255.0 >>> Gateway = 10.20.17.2 >>> Cash Register connection: no
How to re-initialize terminal
Start the TS3 (see above). You require a license with level 3 or higher.
Check connection settings as desribed before (see above).
Follow the steps:
Remote Control >>> Start >>> Diagnosis>>> Initialisation
Diagnosis
Start the TS3 (see above). You require a license with level 3 or higher.
Check connection settings as desribed before (see above).
Follow the steps:
Remote Control >>> Start >>> Diagnosis >>> Extended Diagnosis ("successful", if OK)
Remote Control >>> Start >>> Diagnosis >>> Configuration Diagnosis ("successful", if OK)
Payment Settings: Remote Control >>> Start >>> Diagnosis >>> EMV Diagnosis ("successful", if OK)
Connection Check: Remote Control >>> Start >>> Diagnosis >>> Line Diagnosis ("successful", if OK)
How to reset factory settings
Start the TS3 (see above). You require a license with level 4 or higher.
Check connection settings as desribed before (see above).
Follow the steps:
Remote Control >>> Start >>> Service >>> Factory Settings
Logs in TS3
Start the TS3 (see above). You require a license with level 3 or higher.
Check connection settings as desribed before (see above).
Follow the steps:
Select >>> Terminal Log >>> Terminal Interaction >>> Load (check for errors (red colored) and clarify with CCV)
Download the full log:
Select icon "read all log and configuration files"
to dowload a full log *.zip (interpretation to be provided by CCV)
Thank you.
With best regards,
